A new phone with microSD. In 2022 it's very difficult to buy a new phone with microSD support. I bought this S20 FE to replace my S9+. It was easy to transfer all my apps and data to the new phone. Unfortunately Samsung deliberately limits the performance of external SD cards to encourage people to buy phones with larger internal storage. My SDXC card can do 91MB/s read and 59MB/s write on my laptop's card reader, but only 74MB/s read and 38MB/s write on S20 FE.

Great phone and great value for the money. I recently purchased the Samsung S20 FE, and I must say, it is truly a great value for the money, especially when compared to its competition. This smartphone offers an impressive combination of features, performance, and affordability. In terms of value for money, the Samsung S20 FE shines. Its pricing is more affordable compared to other flagship smartphones in the market, while still offering comparable features and performance. You're getting a premium smartphone experience without breaking the bank, which is a rare find in today's market. Overall, I am thoroughly impressed with the Samsung S20 FE. It combines top-notch performance, a stunning display, versatile cameras, long battery life, and all at a price that is highly competitive. If you're in the market for a flagship-level smartphone without the exorbitant price tag, the Samsung S20 FE is definitely worth considering.

Browsing feels about the same, even though the S20 FE touts the 120Hz display, but has a lower pixel density in terms of screen resolution. Colorwise, they are about the same in terms of vivid colors or contrast/brightness. - In terms of battery life, I see to get about the same performance as my S9, even though the S20 FE touts a larger battery, but also has a bigger display so it evens out. - In terms of 5G performance, I tested it in a few places and I don't see much improvements in terms of Upload or Download performance over 4G LTE. You screwed that up like a first time manufacturer. And then you decided to sell it anyway. You even mentioned "Games" in your advertising. This is my third Galaxy S10 FE with this same issue. Initial phone was Sprint branded (returned), second was unlocked (waited two weeks for more information and spent over an hour on the phone with Samsung, the Requested replacement), replacement phone has same exact issue. Failing 3/3 of the time... That looks like 1... Yup. 100% failure rate. This is after the October firmware update that was supposed to fix the touch bugs.

Horrible phone. Lots of features do not work. Buyer Beware!. Some features don't work like wifi-calling which is imperative for me. The serial number also doesn't match to any of Samsung's support options, so you can't get through to support. The phone itself is sleek but very slippery. The buttons are not very tactile, ie- hard to turn on/off and adjust volume. The volume is also all over the place, one minute it’s blaring your ears off and the next you can’t hear anything. The touch screen is wonky and doesn’t work very well. I put a verizon sim card into the phone and it worked for one day and now does not. I'm hoping I can resolve these issues as this is supposed to be my work phone, but at this time it is unclear if a resolution will occur.

It works. I was deathly afraid of buying my first refurbished product. But given new phones cost over $1000 and they have a limited lifespan based on how long Samsung will support software amd security updates, this was the economical solution. Best decision I've ever made. I bought it to replace a Samsung S10e with failing battery life that I had for 4yrs. My first 5G phone, the camera have outstanding megapixels, and it is the last model in the lineup with expandable memory. Great for photo/video horders.
this is the one that turned me into an iphone user. Horrible experience with this phone and trying to get support. Keyboarf just stopped doing prrdictive text and spell check

Buyers beware.... I purchased this phone via PDI Mobile and all was fine... till i removed the warranty sticker. Which was in a odd location to begin with. Hastily slapped on the back. I removed it. To my surprise there was a nasty huge scratch in the back. Which is absolutely unacceptable when you bought a "excellent condition" RENEWED! WHICH MEANS WORK MUST BE DONE to bring the phone back to a close as new as possible, me removing the warranty tag insures me that i probably won't get a replacement or refund. Best to Avoid PDI Mobile
Good buy. So far am happy with my selection. It's simular to its replacement and is easy to operate.

Does NOT support boost. I feel pretty lied to since it said it was unlocked to all carries, but when I put my virgin mobile/boost disk into it, it said it wasn't supported so it doesn't support everyone.

BUYER BEWARE. ***** I usually don't give bad reviews but I don't want anyone else to experience this*****phone looked okay only had a few scratches but the prices was GREAT so I kept it. I had the "unlocked Tbmoile version. It worked great for 4 days I was on top of the world then all of a sudden service was disconnected in the middle of the day while I was in class. I have small children so this is a major problem. Took it to tmobile to see why my services was turned off and they told me that the phone was purchased overseas? And can NO longer be activated on there network. I call Amazon to troubleshoot or get an exchange I was told to I need to email the seller? So I read online and see that I have a 90 day easy return on this phone.

No eSIM Support. If you plan on traveling internationally and need eSIM support, this phone has eSIM disabled by Samsung. The hardware is there but for some reason (likely politics between US carriers and Samsung) you cannot use this feature.
Came as described. Two month later, still happy with this purchase. Product as described, arrived in minty condition. Quick response from support as well!

Good product.. I would recommend a renewed version. Positive features. Seamless Samsung "Smart Switch" upgrading information from old phone to the new version. Nice upgrades. The phone is like new to me. Positive transaction and customer service with the company.

Screen not repaired properly. The screen flickers and appears to havvbve not been repaired properly. When I contacted the seller to return, they wanted me to return phone first before a replacement was sent. What a hassle to not be with a phone or have to transfer everything again. I would like to return but only if I am sent replacement first. Never received an answer when I made this request.

Phone did not work and neither did Amazon customer service. Phone was offered at a great Black Friday price. When I received it, it would not start up regardless of what I did. The Amazon customer service rep and I contacted Samsung and they were not able to troubleshoot. I wanted to return the phone to Amazon and get a replacement but they are now out of stock. I'm willing to return the faulty phone and get a replacement but wanted my same Black Friday price. Amazon would not give that to me. The only option is a refund. They didn't seem particularly eager to make it work. I'm disappointed. Amazon has always been customer friendly in the past. Maybe Samsung will provide a replacement. Update on Dec. 14, 2022 I called Amazon again and got someone who was willing to help. I explained my situation and pretty quickly I had a new phone on its way.

07_rewrite.text: A+ Seller. Purchased this S20 which arrived looking and acting brand new. Completely satisfied with the purchase. 2+ months in, the power button began to malfunction. I reached out to Bay Shine customer service, and was immediately offered a replacement or refund, no questions asked. I opted to return for refund-- one day before the 90 day warranty was up. A full refund was issued in two days time. Although I didn't keep the product, I want potential buyers to know about this great buyer experience- I would highly recommend purchasing from this seller.

Quality product, Exceptional support - Buyer stands by his product. Item arrived prior to estimated delivery date, was packaged exceptionally well, came with a new rapid charger, and a set of return instruction which included Seller contact number. Quality of item was superb and as described. Contacted Seller with device set-up inquiries. He set aside time to answer all questions, and was quite patient. All inquiries were resolved. I don't dole-out compliments easily, but based on this purchase and experience I'd definitely return to do business again.

Awesome experience with the seller. This phone was shipped out promptly and was to arrive in record time but FedEx mess up the process. Soon after I contacted the seller, he responded by text and phone calls. The seller very customer focused and dependable. Seller worked with me, agreed on a replacement phone and shipped with a different carrier. I will recommend this seller anytime and feel confident doing business with them. The phone worked perfectly well and as described. thumbs up thumbs up thumbs up thumbs up thumbs up
Great experience. I had some question about the samsung i purchased and the seller answered all my questions promptly. I am very happy with my device and the customer service provided by the seller.

A new phone with microSD. In 2022 it's very difficult to buy a new phone with microSD support. I bought this S20 FE to replace my S9+. It was easy to transfer all my apps and data to the new phone. Unfortunately Samsung deliberately limits the performance of external SD cards to encourage people to buy phones with larger internal storage. My SDXC card can do 91MB/s read and 59MB/s write on my laptop's card reader, but only 74MB/s read and 38MB/s write on S20 FE.
POS - Samsung customer service no help. Phone keeps on overheating and shutting down. Samsung customer service refuses to replace it. If you want a product with customer support, look elsehwere.
